name: prenuncio-baseline
title: Prenúncio baseline: boosted trees blended with a U-Net
summary: Gradient boosted trees on a 500 m grid and a U-Net on 100 m tiles, both reading the JRC Tropical Moist Forest disturbance record, blended half and half by geometric mean. This is the forecast shown on prenuncio.com.

data_sources.name: INPE PRODES raster, Legal Amazon, 2025 release (v20261019)
data_sources.dates: Clearing by PRODES year, 2008 to 2025. A forecast of year T reads years up to T-1.

data_sources.name: INPE PRODES 2026 increments, priority scenes (v20261016)
data_sources.dates: August 2025 to July 2026. Used as the 2026 outcome and as the last year of history for the 2027 forecast.

data_sources.name: INPE DETER-B alerts
data_sources.dates: Daily since August 2016. A forecast of year T reads alerts detected up to 31 July of T-1.

data_sources.name: Hansen Global Forest Change v1.13, loss year
data_sources.dates: Calendar years 2001 to 2025. A forecast of year T reads loss up to calendar year T-2.

data_sources.name: GLAD Sentinel-2 forest disturbance alerts, University of Maryland
data_sources.dates: Alert dates from 2019. A forecast of year T reads alerts up to 31 July of T-1, from T-1 = 2020 on.
data_sources.license: Open, with attribution to the GLAD laboratory, University of Maryland

data_sources.name: JRC Tropical Moist Forest v1 (2025 release), first degradation year and first deforestation year
data_sources.dates: Calendar years 1982 to 2025. A forecast of year T reads first-disturbance years up to calendar year T-2. Only the earlier of the two years is used.
data_sources.license: Open, with attribution to the European Commission Joint Research Centre (Vancutsem et al. 2021)

data_sources.name: AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding, annual, Google and Google DeepMind
data_sources.dates: Calendar years 2018 to 2025. A forecast of year T reads the embeddings of calendar years T-2 and T-3.

data_sources.name: INPE Queimadas active fire detections, reference satellite
data_sources.dates: 2003 on. A forecast of year T reads detections up to July of T-1.
data_sources.license: Open data of INPE, with attribution

data_sources.name: IBAMA open data: embargoes and flora infraction notices
data_sources.dates: A forecast of year T reads records dated up to July of T-1. The file is today's snapshot of those records.
data_sources.license: Open data of IBAMA, with attribution

data_sources.name: Indigenous lands, conservation units, municipalities and states, as distributed by INPE
data_sources.dates: Conservation units enter by creation year. Indigenous lands and boundaries are a current snapshot.

compute.hardware: One cloud machine with 16 vCPU, 64 GB of RAM and one NVIDIA L4 GPU (24 GB)

tools.name: Claude Code (Anthropic), coding agents
tools.how: Agents wrote most of the pipeline, ran the experiments in docs/BENCH.md and drafted this report. The maintainer set the goals, chose what to try and what to publish, and read the results.
